metadata.description: Trust over speed: a discipline framework for coding agents — four Iron Laws, 11 skills, and a mechanical enforcement layer that does not rely on the model choosing to load anything.

plugins.name: trust-no-agent
plugins.description: The router plus the enforcement layer. Skills are inert without the router (self-trigger measured at 0/3), so this plugin ships both: the trigger matrix and Iron Laws, and the hooks that re-inject the floor after compaction and classify each prompt against the three MANDATORY domains.
